title: Bodega™ Persistent Shops
description: Persistent Cyberpunk RED bodegas with protected vendor purses/actor ledgers, serialized GM-authoritative purchases and live stock updates, package-aware proportional buybacks for ammo/stacked goods with unverified-stack GM-review protection, Fixer/Operator pricing and optional automatic high-price Fixer gating, static + dynamic inventory, multiple RollTable/pack sources, Simple Calendar customer traffic and daily restocking, scrollable curated-source search, direct Monk's Active Tile binding, and a tile-friendly API.
